owner_and_capability: Session End application workflow over Student Presence GroupSessionCommand and Timetable Commands
atomic_cutover: Kiosk session end calls one workflow in the caller's tenant UnitOfWork; all session-ending Presence writes use owner commands. Timetable completion remains one owner-backed provider. No dual writer or fallback read chain.
tests: Kiosk HTTP end/current/repeat-close, workflow owner failure and outer rollback, after-commit notification, two-tenant owner contracts, real Cancel/session-end serialization, complete/cancel/nightly/takeover caller suites.

runtime_evidence.workload: Local isolated PostgreSQL 17.11, Go 1.27.0, concurrency 1; 5 warmups and 30 calls per operation. Real composed workflow including Timetable completion, one supervisor and two student assignments. Fixture creation excluded.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No task-specific SLO or query budget is defined. Existing behavior, architecture and composition gates apply. Measurements are not production thresholds or a before/after benchmark.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Mirrored end 34 statements and 5 DML rows; already-ended rejection 5 statements and zero DML rows.
runtime_evidence.errors: No unexpected errors; repeated calls consistently return ErrSessionAlreadyEnded. No pool waits or database deadlock counter increments. Lock sampling observed zero waiters, subject to sampling gaps.
runtime_evidence.failure: Cancel/session-end lock inversion reproduced with SQLSTATE 55P03, then fixed and verified using both real operations. Owner completion failure and caller abort preserve all Presence writes and suppress notifications.
runtime_evidence.rollback: One tenant UnitOfWork rolls back Presence and Timetable operations; notifications execute only after commit. Existing integration tests inject completion and outer-caller failures.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Real kiosk route test verifies visit checkout, mirrored completion, expected-student finalization, repeated-close response and foreign-tenant preservation. Repository-wide affected checks and CI are required before merge.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert workflow wiring against unchanged table shapes if needed; transactional failures roll back before after-commit notifications. No irreversible cleanup or schema change. Later Timetable/Presence schema split stays #2762.
exit_criterion: Listed session-end entrypoints use single owner providers and retain tenant contracts. Architecture ownership and shrink-only baselines remain unchanged except reviewed epoch-4 data-less workflow registration under ADR 0013.
